description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Common', which provides common functionality for all classes in the Image_Graph package, including methods for managing elements, canvas, error handling, and output.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Common
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for Image_Graph classes, including element management, canvas handling, and output.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the elements of the object, calling _reset on each sub-element.

methods.name: _setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent of the current object and propagates to sub-elements.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the element by setting its visibility to false.

methods.name: _getCanvas
methods.description: Retrieves the canvas object, either from the current object or its parent.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an existing element to the object's element list.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Creates a new object of specified class and adds it to the element list.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Displays an error message on the canvas.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes output to the canvas, invoking done() on sub-elements.
